fields.Name: SFMC API
fields.Description: Salesforce Marketing Cloud ENGAGEMENT (formerly ExactTarget) API credentials. OAuth2 client-credentials against a tenant-specific token endpoint, {subdomain}.auth.marketingcloudapis.com/v2/token, issued by an Installed Package's API Integration (Server-to-Server) component. The REST and SOAP base URIs are READ FROM the token response (rest_instance_url / soap_instance_url) and never hardcoded; the same bearer token authenticates SOAP via the <fueloauth> header. Optional account_id (MID) selects a business unit. Tokens are short-lived (vendor guidance: refresh on expires_in, do not request more than one token per 20 minutes), so the connector refreshes proactively rather than reacting to a 401.
